sources.title: VibeVoice-7B: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview VibeVoice-7B is an open-source text-to-speech model built by vibevoice that generates expressive, long-form, multi-speaker conversational audio such as podcasts from text. The model uses continuous speech tokenizers (Acoustic and Semantic) operating at 7.5 Hz frame rate combined with a Qwen2.5 LLM backbone and a diffusion-based decoding head to synthesize speech up to 90 minutes long ...

sources.title: GitHub - microsoft/VibeVoice: Open-Source Frontier Voice AI
sources.snippet: VibeVoice is a family of open-source frontier voice AI models that includes both Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models. A core innovation of VibeVoice is its use of continuous speech tokenizers (Acoustic and Semantic) operating at an ultra-low frame rate of 7.5 Hz.
